description: 1. Agent reads content_ideas.md and identifies all {AGENT_NAME} placeholders, replacing them with 'Hana' (from ops/config/sns_config.yaml or by deduction). 2. Agent reads sns_management/published/published_log.csv and populates the 完了済み section using the exact 4-column schema (ID | 投稿日 | 内容 | 反応). 3. Agent adds ≥2 new rows to すぐ使えるアイデア with IDs continuing from 003 (i.e., 004, 005...), using the ⭐ star priority notation (1-3 stars), valid platform values (X, Threads, Note, or combinations), and valid category names from the YAML taxonomy. The new ideas must reference April seasonal events from the calendar section. 4. Agent adds ≥1 row to 検討中のアイデア using the correct 4-column schema (ID | カテゴリ | アイデア | メモ). 5. Agent updates the 更新履歴 block with a new dated entry. Key traps: wrong priority notation (e.g., 'high' instead of ⭐⭐⭐), wrong column counts in tables, not following the ID numbering system, using categories outside the defined YAML taxonomy, and forgetting to replace all {AGENT_NAME} instances.
